header.title: Support
header.subtitle: Billing, account, and technical help for Vedaansh

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: We usually reply within 3–5 business days. Include your registered email and, for billing issues, your Razorpay payment ID or receipt.

topics.title: Common topics
topics.payment: Payment failed or paying from outside India — on Pricing, choose “Request help with payment”. We'll send a PayPal invoice or Wise / UPI details and activate your plan once paid.
topics.cancel: Cancel renewal — Account → Billing & privacy → Cancel renewal
topics.export: Export or delete your data — Account → Billing & privacy
